structure.code:
let posX = 0 
let posY = 0
let boxDim = 100
function setup() {
	createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight, WEBGL)
	
}

function draw() {
	background(0)
	orbitControl()
	fill(255)
	
	posX+= 10
	posY= posY -10
	
	if (posX > (width/2)+(boxDim/2)) {
		posX = -width/2
	}
	
	if(posY < - (height/2)){
		posY= 0
	}
	
	push()
	translate(posX, posY, 0)
	box(100)
	box (boxDim)
	pop()
	
	
	strokeWeight(3)
	push()
	stroke (255,0,0)
	line(0,0,0, width,0,0)
	stroke (0,255,0)
	line(0,0,0, 0,-height,0)
	stroke(0,0,255)
	line(0,0,0, 0,0,1000)
	pop()
}
